name: capture-team
description:
An AI Capture Team of specialized Digital Employees that helps practitioners identify opportunities, assess fit against organizational criteria, prioritize where to spend limited pursuit capacity, and turn the resulting intelligence into decision-ready Capture Briefs.

Use it across government contracting, grants and funding, or business development workflows. Bring your own organizational criteria, CRM, enrichment tools, opportunity sources, and document storage.

Nothing is pre-wired to a specific vendor. Chet discovers, Kipp qualifies and prioritizes, and Ben turns the result into a decision-ready brief.

Want to build, customize, and manage AI Teams for your own workflows?

THINK School on Skool teaches you how.
